profile.name: Aric Allen
profile.headline: I build interfaces people love to use — and codebases people love to work in.
profile.bio: Staff frontend engineer with 10+ years of shipping polished, accessible web apps — AI agent workspaces and MCP apps at dbt Labs, design systems and ads tooling at Reddit, developer platforms at Sysdig and Apple. Berklee-trained musician who brings the same ear for craft to the codebase.
profile.quote: Be the change you want to see in the codebase.

projects.title: MCP Apps to GA
projects.summary: Interactive MCP apps rendered inside AI hosts — from RFC to general availability.
highlights: Authored the RFC and led the initiative from prototype to GA
Shipped custom UI embedded in dbt, VS Code, and Claude Desktop
Defined the rendering contract between MCP servers and host UIs

details.overview: MCP Apps let servers ship rich, interactive UI that renders directly inside AI hosts. I authored the internal RFC, aligned host teams across three surfaces, and led the work from a hackweek prototype to a GA product — designing the protocol layer for how apps declare, sandbox, and render their UI.
details.role: Tech lead — RFC author, protocol design, frontend implementation across three host surfaces.
outcomes: GA launch across dbt, VS Code, and Claude Desktop
Rendering contract adopted as the standard for internal MCP app development
Unblocked downstream teams to ship their own MCP apps without host changes

projects.title: Insights Analysis Agent
projects.summary: An AI data analyst with streaming responses, tool calling, and live SQL execution.
highlights: Shipped dbt's Insights analysis agent to GA
Built streaming UI with incremental tool-call rendering
Live SQL execution with result visualization in the chat surface

details.overview: Insights is dbt's conversational analysis agent: ask a question in plain English, watch it plan, write SQL, run it against your warehouse, and chart the results — all streamed token-by-token into a purpose-built chat surface. I owned the frontend: the streaming architecture, incremental rendering of tool calls, and the embedded result visualizations.
details.role: Frontend lead — streaming architecture, tool-call UI, result rendering.
outcomes: GA launch as a flagship AI feature of the dbt platform
Streaming patterns reused by two other agent surfaces
Sub-second first-token render on warehouse-scale queries

projects.title: Dev-Agent Workspace
projects.summary: A full-screen workspace for reviewing AI code edits — inline diffs and DAG-level impact review.
highlights: Frontend lead for the dev-agent workspace
Inline diff review of AI-proposed edits across many files
DAG visualization showing downstream impact of every change

details.overview: When an AI agent edits your dbt project, you need to trust the change before you ship it. This workspace gives engineers a full-screen review surface: file-by-file inline diffs of agent edits, plus a DAG view showing which downstream models each change touches — so review happens at both the code level and the dependency level.
details.role: Frontend lead — workspace shell, diff rendering, DAG review integration.
outcomes: Became the primary review surface for agent-driven edits
Diff + DAG dual review reduced bad merges from agent changes
Workspace shell reused for two additional editor features

projects.title: React 19 + Compiler Migration
projects.summary: Led the React 19 + Compiler migration across six repos, cutting render time by ~54%.
highlights: React rendering time cut by ~54% across the platform
Unified five frontend apps into one monorepo
CDN-split the editor core to fix chronic CI failures

details.overview: A platform-wide modernization: migrate six repositories to React 19 with the React Compiler enabled, then consolidate five frontend apps into a single monorepo. Along the way I CDN-split the heavyweight editor core out of the main bundle, which eliminated a class of chronic CI failures and sped up every team's pipeline.
details.role: Migration lead — planning, codemods, rollout sequencing, performance measurement.
outcomes: ~54% reduction in React rendering time measured across key surfaces
Five apps consolidated into one monorepo with shared tooling
Chronic editor-related CI failures eliminated via CDN split

projects.title: Design Token Pipeline
projects.summary: Figma-to-npm design token pipeline powering dark mode, theming, and a brand refresh across six repos.
highlights: Lead architect for the Figma → npm token pipeline
Enabled seamless dark mode and theming rollout
Brand refresh shipped across six repositories from one source of truth

details.overview: Design tokens lived in Figma; the six ads repos each hardcoded their own colors. I architected a pipeline that syncs tokens from Figma into a versioned npm package — typed, themeable, and consumed everywhere. When the brand refresh and dark mode landed, they rolled out across all six repos by bumping a dependency.
details.role: Lead architect — pipeline design, token schema, rollout across consuming teams.
outcomes: Dark mode + brand refresh rolled out across six repositories
Single source of truth replaced per-repo hardcoded palettes
Adopted by the Frontend Guild as the standard theming path

projects.title: Ads Search Platform
projects.summary: Internal search platform for cross-team discovery and action on ad data.
highlights: Built the internal ad search platform end to end
Collapsed a 15+ shared-package dev loop into a single step
Scaled ad review microservices for new ad products

details.overview: Ads data was scattered across systems with no unified way to find or act on it. I built an internal search platform that let any team discover ads, inspect their state, and take action — plus the local-dev tooling that collapsed a painful 15+ shared-package development loop into a single command.
details.role: Full-stack engineer — search UI, API gateway integration, DX tooling.
outcomes: Cross-team ad discovery in one place, replacing tribal knowledge
Local-dev loop for shared packages reduced to a single step
Ad review services scaled to support new ad product launches
